decisionsTitle: The waiting-list setting says what it does, and the backoffice spells «BIB» one way
decisionsSection:
Two wording changes, no behaviour.

**A. The setting's name.** §615 named the editor's «Da»/«Nu» select «Ofertele din lista de așteptare pleacă automat». The owner (2026-10-01): «Nu îmi place cum sună 'ofertele din lista de așteptare merg automat'», then «Zi 'locurile din lista de alocă automat'». The label is now «Locurile din lista de așteptare se alocă automat» (en «Places from the waiting list are allocated automatically»). The label follows the owner's words, but the help still says the mechanism, because «alocă» on «Da» means an offer with a deadline that the person must accept and sign (`fillAvailableSpots` makes a WAITLIST_SPOT_OFFER), not a seat given outright: «Pe „Da”, un loc eliberat sau adăugat se alocă pe loc primului de pe lista de așteptare: primește oferta pe email și o confirmă până la termen. Pe „Nu”, locurile rămân libere până le dai tu.» (its English twin, shortened to the 200 characters §511 allows backoffice help: «On “Yes”, a freed or added place is offered at once, by email and with a deadline, to the first on the waiting list. On “No”, places stay free until you hand them out.»; neither names the button, `waitlistAutoOfferHelpMore` does); «Da»/«Nu» stay, and `waitlistAutoOfferHelpMore` keeps its content. Every place that quoted the old label follows: the guide's steps (§620) and the two guide sentences that said the offers «nu pleacă automat», `SETUP.md` §39's recipe, code comments and the tests that assert the words. The column `events.waitlist_auto_offer`, its values, the audit action `event.waitlist_auto_offer_changed` and the behaviour are untouched.

**B. «BID» becomes «BIB».** The backoffice's catalogue strings said «BID» for the race number. The owner, in the review of `fix/race-number-column-says-bib`: «BIB, ăsta e termenul tehnic». Romanian keeps the hyphenated forms of today's «BID-ul»: «BIB-ul», «BIB-uri», «BIB-urile». Changed in both catalogues (the printing mark, the desk guide, the start list's toggle and alt text, the guide's steps) and in the e2e assertions. Not touched, on purpose: the journey chip «nr. {number}» / «no. {number}» and the desk's «Salvează nr.» — the owner asked for the column's and the technical term's spelling, not every short form; and the owner's quoted words in code comments, which keep their original spelling. «FORBIDDEN» is not the race number and stays.

Refused: a new key, an ICU change, any migration.

**Supersedes in `SPECS.md`.** BR-REQ-034-02 criterion 18 quotes the old label «Ofertele din lista de așteptare pleacă automat», and BR-REQ-038-01 criterion 16 spells the chip «BID N tipărit — de retras»; both are read with the new words («Locurile din lista de așteptare se alocă automat», «BIB N tipărit — de retras»).
changelogLine: **«Locurile din lista de așteptare se alocă automat», and «BIB» everywhere** — the setting says what it does; the backoffice spells the race number's term one way. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given the event editor, when it draws the waiting-list setting, then its label is «Locurile din lista de așteptare se alocă automat» (en «Places from the waiting list are allocated automatically»), which supersedes the label quoted in criterion 18 («Ofertele din lista de așteptare pleacă automat»), and its help says that on «Da» a freed or added place is offered at once, by email and with a deadline, to the first on the list, and on «Nu» it stays free until the club gives it; the guide, `SETUP.md` and the tests quote the same words; the column, its values and the behaviour are unchanged (2026-10-01, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given the backoffice in either language, when it names the race number's printing mark, the desk guide's numbers or the start list's toggle, then it spells the term «BIB» («BIB-ul», «BIB-uri», «BIB-urile» in Romanian) and never «BID»; the chip of criterion 16 therefore reads «BIB N tipărit — de retras», superseding its spelling «BID N tipărit — de retras»; the short forms «nr.» and «no.» are unchanged (2026-10-01, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: waiting-list setting renamed «Locurile din lista de așteptare se alocă automat»; «BID» → «BIB» in the catalogues (§NNN)
